The remote authenticated SSH service the attacker brute-forces (T1110.001) and pivots through (T1021.004). A FREE, analyst-authored implementation choice: the corpus pins only that a remote authenticated service must exist, not which SSH server realises it. The non-uniqueness witness substitutes it (OpenSSH <-> Dropbear) and executes both to completion under one corpus fingerprint.
